posts.title: What’s on in Lewes
posts.caption: Lewes does not exactly do quiet. Film, music, workshops, food, exhibitions and local discoveries — gathered into one useful guide. Find it on the map, check what is coming up, and go somewhere interesting.

posts.title: Your weekend, sorted
posts.caption: Stop finding out on Monday what you could have done on Saturday. LewesLive brings local events, places and useful information together before the weekend disappears.

posts.title: Map-first local discovery
posts.caption: The best local guide is not just a list. It is a map, a card, a route, a reason to visit, and a reminder that half the good stuff is hiding in plain sight.

posts.title: Built for local businesses
posts.caption: Independent places need better visibility than a buried search result and a tired Facebook post. PostcodeLive turns local listings into map cards, directory pages and social material.

posts.title: BrightonLive next
posts.caption: The same engine can power bigger local guides: neighbourhoods, venues, events, food, travel and social output — one structured system instead of a pile of disconnected posts.

posts.title: Live local by postcode
posts.caption: Lewes first. Brighton next. Then every postcode that deserves a better local guide. PostcodeLive is the shared engine underneath the local brands.
